name: bento-chatgpt-sdk
description: Connect ChatGPT to Bento for subscriber, email, automation, analytics, deliverability, and support workflows.

interface.shortDescription: Run Bento marketing and support workflows in ChatGPT.
interface.longDescription: Connect ChatGPT to a Bento site through a hosted MCP server. Review subscribers, broadcasts, sequences, workflows, analytics, deliverability, and Bento Chat conversations, then create or update records when you approve the action.
defaultPrompt: Use Bento to check a subscriber's status.
Use Bento to review email deliverability for the last 24 hours.
Use Bento to draft a broadcast and wait for my approval before sending.
